existing_group_assignments.rationale: Displacement of serum T4 from a carrier protein is the same process as displacement from transthyretin, with a more general carrier-protein object, so it is flagged for curator review.
Increased cell proliferation in general, same process and direction as the other members of this group.
Decreased photosystem II efficiency concerns photosystem II but is a distinct functional measure from inhibition or decreased electron transport.
Decreased reproduction is a closely related population-level reproductive outcome alongside decreased fecundity and reproductive success.

new_groups.rationale: Chitin synthase inhibition and decreased cuticular chitin content both concern chitin synthesis but are distinct events, enzyme versus product.
Binding of thyroid binding globulin in serum and displacement of T4 from a carrier protein both concern serum thyroid hormone carrier proteins but are distinct processes.
Hyperinflammation and systemic inflammatory response syndrome are the same inflammatory process at different scope.
